code: body { animation: feralPulse 0.8s infinite alternate cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } @keyframes feralPulse { 0% { filter: hue-rotate(0deg) blur(0px) contrast(1); transform: scale(1); } 100% { filter: hue-rotate(20deg) blur(3px) contrast(1.3); transform: scale(1.03); } } #omniscope-root { box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(255, 0, 80, 0.6) inset; }

@keyframes decoherence-blur { 0% { filter: blur(0px) contrast(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { filter: blur(4px) contrast(1.2); opacity: 0.85; transform: scale(1.005); } 100% { filter: blur(0px) contrast(1); opacity: 1; } } body::before { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; backdrop-filter: blur(0px); animation: decoherence-blur 4s infinite ease-in-out; z-index: 9999; mix-blend-mode: overlay; }
